scenes.text: How did democracy thrive in India despite vast diversity and poverty?
scenes.narration: Have you ever wondered why India's democracy survived while others collapsed despite poverty and diversity? The secret lies in our consensus Constitution.

scenes.text: A society thrives when sharing power among diverse residents rather than imposing one rule.
scenes.narration: As an everyday analogy, imagine a big housing society. When the management shares authority and accommodates different residents instead of forcing one rule, everyone lives together in harmony.

scenes.heading: Cornerstone of the Nation
items: Part IV combines liberalism, socialism, and Gandhism
Flexibility ensured democratic survival across decades
scenes.narration: Indian democracy succeeded because our Constitution is a consensus document. In Part Four, it reconciled liberalism with socialism and Gandhism, making it the true cornerstone of our nation.

scenes.heading: Integration and Regional Autonomy
scenes.narration: Nehru viewed India as a nation in the making. While national integration is essential for security and development, scholars note that regionalism naturally arises from uneven development and scarcity.

scenes.heading: Resolving Regional Conflict
scenes.narration: Look at how India handled regional demands. Tamil sub-nationalism reached a permanent resolution through democratic accommodation, while Kashmir faced foreign interference and excessive force.

scenes.name: Atul Kohli
scenes.idea: Democracy triggers ethnic mobilization but also provides the only solution.
scenes.narration: Here is the trick from thinker Atul Kohli. He points out that democracy encourages ethnic mobilization, but democratic politics also provides the only lasting solution to those movements.

scenes.heading: Devolution and Sovereignty
items: Sarkaria and Punchhi commissions urged power devolution
Sovereignty encompasses legal, political, and popular types
Criticisms challenge monistic theory of sovereignty
scenes.narration: To resolve regional tensions, the Sarkaria and Punchhi commissions recommended devolving powers. In political science, sovereignty is examined through legal, political, and popular types, alongside monistic theory.

items: Consensus Constitution is the cornerstone of Indian democracy
Democratic accommodation successfully resolves regional movements
Power devolution and popular sovereignty strengthen unity
scenes.narration: Remember these three big ideas. A consensus constitution preserves democracy, democratic accommodation resolves regional conflicts, and devolving power balances national unity with regional autonomy.
